name: Doug Vickrey
occupation: Sublette County commissioner (serving through the current term, which ends January 2, 2027)

background: Douglas J. Vickrey, also listed as Doug Vickrey, is a Sublette County commissioner, serving through the end of the current term on January 2, 2027. The official commissioner profiles page lists him as a member with that term date. He won the November 2022 general election and lost the August 2026 Republican primary for a new term. Incoming commissioner Andy Nelson takes office in January 2027.
